title: Standard WOFOST rate-versus-state reconciliation

scope.purpose: prove which rates are event-local and isolate the narrow saved-rate values that B1.10 actually reads across crop-event boundaries

source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.finding: GLAIEXP is recomputed only while LAIEXP<6, while update_wofost continues adding the saved GLAIEXP to committed LAIEXP after the threshold
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.future_state_effect: changes later LAIEXP and therefore is required for exact B1.10 code continuation in the carryover regime
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.minimum_storage: one scalar only when the exact-code reference path requires it

source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.finding: once fl_vernalised is true, vernrate can remain saved while task 3 continues adding it to VERN
source_bound_cross_event_exceptions.minimum_storage: one scalar only for the exact-code IDSL=2 compatibility path

saved_but_not_continuation.finding: may also remain stale after LAIEXP>=6, but no scoped standard-route cross-event state feedback was found

structural_candidate_rule: A future structural candidate must either carry the narrow compatibility memories on the exact B1.10 reference path or establish an explicit theory-code discrepancy and expected-difference qualification. It may not silently reset the saved values or persist the whole WOFOST_rates object.
